name: Bot It AI
summary: Shopify app that audits every product for the data AI shopping agents rank on (categories, attributes, barcodes, alt text, variants, policies), maintains llms.txt and agents.md, and on Pro writes the missing fields with one-click revert and tracks placement in AI shopping results. Launched May 2026, no reviews yet.
best_for: Shopify merchants who want to know how complete their catalogue data is for AI shopping agents and are willing to test an early tool, starting with the free audit before paying for automated fixes
skip_if: you want a proven, heavily reviewed SEO or feed app today; your catalogue is small enough to fix by hand from the free audit; or you need a published cap on AI usage before you commit
honest_knock:
The budget behind the AI fixes is not published. Pro's automated fixes draw on a monthly token budget the vendor describes only as generous. Its FAQ puts a typical product at about a thousand tokens to enrich once and says the app stops proposing, never mid-write, when you reach the ceiling. For a catalogue of a few hundred products that is unlikely to matter. For tens of thousands of SKUs, or for re-enriching after every catalogue change, ask for the number in writing before you rely on it.

It is a bet on a channel that is still small. The app prepares your catalogue for AI shopping agents, including ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Claude, and tracks where your products place in their results. For most stores those agents are not yet a meaningful source of orders, so the rank tracker and the agent-traffic analytics may show very little for a while. The audit is useful regardless, because the fields it checks (categories, attributes, barcodes, alt text, variants, policies) also feed shopping feeds and on-site search.

Almost nobody has reviewed it yet. The app launched on the Shopify App Store on 8 May 2026 and had a single review on 11 November 2026: five stars, dated 5 October 2026, from a UK store after 18 days of use, praising the scan and the fixes in general terms. That is still no outside account of how accurate its generated attributes are. Start in Full Review mode, where every proposal waits for your approval, before you let Full Auto write to your live catalogue.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Pro · per month for the automated AI fixes, rank tracking and the enrichment proxy, billed through Shopify every 30 days with a 30-day free trial
pricing.notes: (read 2026-09-24 on apps.shopify.com/bot-it and on the vendor's own botitai.com/pricing, which list the same two tiers; re-read unchanged on 2026-11-11) Free is free forever, with no trial involved: the full catalogue audit and Agent Readiness Score across 13 checks per product, the store gates check (password, robots.txt, UCP profile, sitemap), native llms.txt, agents.md and robots.txt theme files, a brand voice editor, unlimited product and collection narratives, and email support. Category-attribute proposals are shown on Free but not applied. Pro is $29 a month with a 30-day free trial and adds the automated AI fixes for alt text, SEO fields, attributes and narratives under three automation levels with one-click revert, the nightly AI Rank Tracker against named competitors, IndexNow broadcast on product changes, the MCP Enrichment Proxy, a bring-your-own-LLM connector, review integration, AI-agent traffic analytics, knowledge-base sync, 90-day log retention and priority support. Pro's AI fixes draw on a monthly token budget the vendor calls generous but does not quantify, and there is no enterprise tier yet. Billed in USD through Shopify every 30 days.

compare_with.name: StoreSEO
compare_with.why: StoreSEO is the closest comparison in our own dossiers, and the two now overlap on the newest ground: both generate an llms.txt and an agents.md. StoreSEO (read 19 August 2026) is a conventional Shopify SEO suite metered on products and AI credits: Free covers 25 products and 200 credits, Lite at $14.99 a month covers 100 products and 1,000 credits, Essential at $39.99 covers 250 products and 5,000 credits, with keyword tracking, schema markup and sitemap submission aimed at Google. Bot It scores the whole catalogue for free with no product cap and charges a flat $29 for the fixes, but it aims at AI shopping agents rather than search engines and publishes no usage number. A store whose traffic comes from Google is better served by StoreSEO's ladder; a store that wants every product scored for agent readiness at no cost can start with Bot It's free audit.

exit_test.what: The app was installed on our Shopify development store, which we set up, and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 17 November 2026 the session tested Bot It (Bot It AI in the dossier) on a Shopify development store: the install, the dashboard score, the free catalog scan with its six gaps and six store-level gates, the Billing page, the Shopify approval screen for Pro (not approved), the Free plan and the uninstall dialog, after which the app was uninstalled. Nothing was paid and nothing was saved in the theme. Install: in the Shopify App Store and in the admin the app is called Bot It (developer Immersive Ecommerce); the dossier calls it Bot It AI. The install form was sent at 12:37:35 in our own tab; the Install app dialog asked for View customer data, View staff and contributor data and View and edit store data (customers, products, orders, store analytics, Online Store, custom data) and was approved. The dashboard opened without a separate account, demo or phone number. The app is not a chatbot but an audit for AI shopping agents. First screen: AI Agent Visibility Score 23/100 with grade F, Get Started 0/7 complete and as quick win 1: Remove password protection to unlock AI agents. Core action: Discovery and Scan catalog (free plan), 2 clicks from the dashboard, with the result visible about 2 to 3 minutes after the install (about 12:40). Result: Catalog Readiness 32 with grade F, Average product score across 19 products, and the gaps 4 Images missing alt text, 28 Variants missing GTIN, 18 Uncategorized products, 0 Category attributes unset, 19 Thin descriptions and 19 Failing products (score under 50). A banner says 19 products awaiting AI enrichment. The buttons Generate fixes with AI (Pro) and Broadcast (Pro) were greyed out on Free, and the AI token budget box says: Upgrade to Pro to unlock AI-generated alt text, attribute extraction, SEO fields, and agent narratives. Store-level gates: Fail Storefront publicly reachable (Storefront is password-protected), Pass robots.txt allows AI crawlers, Fail /agents.md live (Blocked by storefront password page), Fail /llms.txt live, Warn UCP discovery profile (Valid UCP 2026-08-25, 13 capabilities, NO payment handlers) and Warn Agentic discovery sitemap (HTTP 404). The dossier says 13 checks per product; we did not count them: the app shows 6 gap tiles and 6 store gates. Plans: the Shopify pricing page route said No plans are available for your store; the plans are in the app itself on the Billing page. Free $0 a month, Free forever, Current plan: Native llms.txt, agents.md & robots.txt theme files, Daily AI regeneration (copy/paste or CLI install), UCP manifest, Brand voice configuration, Unlimited collection narratives and Unlimited product narratives. Pro $29 a month with a 30-day free trial: Everything in Free, 1-click push & auto-push of theme files, MCP Enrichment Proxy, WebMCP browser tools, Review integration, Full analytics dashboard and Knowledge Base sync. The Billing page does not name the automated AI fixes, the rank tracker or IndexNow under Pro, while Discovery marks the AI fixes and IndexNow as Pro. Checkout: Start free trial opened the Shopify Approve subscription screen: Bot It by Immersive Ecommerce, plan Bot It Pro, You have a 30-day free trial ending on 17 Dec., Subtotal $29,00 plus any applicable taxes, Total $29,00 due 17 Dec., $29,00 USD every 30 days and an Add payment method row. There was no sentence about a test charge and Approve was greyed out, so we did not approve; no card was entered; we pressed Cancel. Cancelling: Pro was not started, so there was nothing to cancel. Removing the app goes through Settings, Apps, the app menu and Uninstall; the dialog says you will no longer be able to use the app, that any data managed by the app, such as discounts, will be deleted, and that a request goes to the app developer within 48 hours to delete all personal customer information. A reason is required (Testing multiple apps); Shopify then confirmed that the app was uninstalled. Not tested: the Pro fixes (alt text, attributes, SEO fields), the Rank Tracker, IndexNow, the MCP proxy, WebMCP, the review integration, brand voice, switching on the theme extension (no theme change was saved), narratives, the Fix Queue and the Products tab. Our development store has 19 products and Pro was not started, so the group of stores with thousands of incomplete products could not be tested. Clean up: the app was uninstalled after the test and no Pro plan was started. No payment method was entered and no theme change was made. Other apps were not touched. Our own tabs were closed. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The app has another name in the admin than in the dossier, the Shopify pricing route says that no plans are available while the plans sit inside the app, the Billing page does not name the AI fixes, the rank tracker or IndexNow under Pro, and the Pro approval screen needs a payment method.

The install form was sent at 12:37:35 in our own tab; the Install app dialog asked for View customer data, View staff and contributor data and View and edit store data (customers, products, orders, store analytics, Online Store, custom data) and was approved. The dashboard opened without a separate account, demo or phone number. The app is not a chatbot but an audit for AI shopping agents. First screen: AI Agent Visibility Score 23/100 with grade F, Get Started 0/7 complete and as quick win 1: Remove password protection to unlock AI agents. Core action: Discovery and Scan catalog (free plan), 2 clicks from the dashboard, with the result visible about 2 to 3 minutes after the install (about 12:40). Result: Catalog Readiness 32 with grade F, Average product score across 19 products, and the gaps 4 Images missing alt text, 28 Variants missing GTIN, 18 Uncategorized products, 0 Category attributes unset, 19 Thin descriptions and 19 Failing products (score under 50). A banner says 19 products awaiting AI enrichment. The buttons Generate fixes with AI (Pro) and Broadcast (Pro) were greyed out on Free, and the AI token budget box says: Upgrade to Pro to unlock AI-generated alt text, attribute extraction, SEO fields, and agent narratives. Store-level gates: Fail Storefront publicly reachable (Storefront is password-protected), Pass robots.txt allows AI crawlers, Fail /agents.md live (Blocked by storefront password page), Fail /llms.txt live, Warn UCP discovery profile (Valid UCP 2026-08-25, 13 capabilities, NO payment handlers) and Warn Agentic discovery sitemap (HTTP 404). The dossier says 13 checks per product; we did not count them: the app shows 6 gap tiles and 6 store gates. Plans: the Shopify pricing page route said No plans are available for your store; the plans are in the app itself on the Billing page. Free $0 a month, Free forever, Current plan: Native llms.txt, agents.md & robots.txt theme files, Daily AI regeneration (copy/paste or CLI install), UCP manifest, Brand voice configuration, Unlimited collection narratives and Unlimited product narratives. Pro $29 a month with a 30-day free trial: Everything in Free, 1-click push & auto-push of theme files, MCP Enrichment Proxy, WebMCP browser tools, Review integration, Full analytics dashboard and Knowledge Base sync. The Billing page does not name the automated AI fixes, the rank tracker or IndexNow under Pro, while Discovery marks the AI fixes and IndexNow as Pro. Checkout: Start free trial opened the Shopify Approve subscription screen: Bot It by Immersive Ecommerce, plan Bot It Pro, You have a 30-day free trial ending on 17 Dec., Subtotal $29,00 plus any applicable taxes, Total $29,00 due 17 Dec., $29,00 USD every 30 days and an Add payment method row. There was no sentence about a test charge and Approve was greyed out, so we did not approve; no card was entered; we pressed Cancel. Cancelling: Pro was not started, so there was nothing to cancel. Removing the app goes through Settings, Apps, the app menu and Uninstall; the dialog says you will no longer be able to use the app, that any data managed by the app, such as discounts, will be deleted, and that a request goes to the app developer within 48 hours to delete all personal customer information. A reason is required (Testing multiple apps); Shopify then confirmed that the app was uninstalled. Not tested: the Pro fixes (alt text, attributes, SEO fields), the Rank Tracker, IndexNow, the MCP proxy, WebMCP, the review integration, brand voice, switching on the theme extension (no theme change was saved), narratives, the Fix Queue and the Products tab. Our development store has 19 products and Pro was not started, so the group of stores with thousands of incomplete products could not be tested. Clean up: the app was uninstalled after the test and no Pro plan was started. No payment method was entered and no theme change was made. Other apps were not touched. Our own tabs were closed. No kit records were entered.
